required_outcomes: Recognises the job is in hand: the landlord approved (event 009), Keystone Compliance was instructed (event 014), the tenant was told they will contact her (event 013), and her acknowledgement (event 015) needs no reply.
Leaves the job waiting for the provider to arrange the visit (or returns it to auto mode) with a dated review point, about two working days out, to check a date has been agreed.
acceptable_alternatives: A brief acknowledgement to the tenant, if it promises nothing new.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the tenant names in the record differ (Clara, Ruben Oakley) without letting it hold up the job.
red_flags: Chasing Keystone Compliance or messaging the landlord less than an hour after the job was sent, with nothing new to say.
prohibited_actions: Assigning another contractor, creating a new ticket, or booking a visit date nobody has agreed.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant a visit date or time that nobody has arranged.
